Flux-wire quick start: install spool, route and clamp wire, remove nozzle/tip, cold-feed wire, tighten tension until wire bends against a wood block at 2–3 inches, reinstall nozzle/tip, then select settings and test.

Cable diagrams: Stick = ground negative/electrode positive; MIG = ground negative/wire-feed power positive; Flux reverses those MIG polarities; TIG = ground positive/torch negative with gas and optional foot pedal.

Decision chart compares Flux-Cored, MIG, Stick, and TIG by skill, gas, materials, thickness, applications, cleanliness, and input voltage; the process columns and 165 A at 30% duty-cycle example were visually checked.
Exterior product view confirms the OmniPro 220 front LCD, Home/Back buttons, three control knobs, power switch, MIG/spool-gun socket, negative/positive output sockets, and wire-feed power lead.

Open-door product view confirms the interior spool/feed layout and placards for rated duty cycles, MIG/Flux, TIG, Stick, wire-spool setup, and wire-feed setup; small placard text is corroborative, not the primary numeric source.
